wikipedia.title: Nileshwaram
wikipedia.text: Nileshwaram or Nileshwar or Neeleshwaram is a municipality and a  major town in Kasaragod District, state of Kerala, India. It is one of the three  municipalities in Kasaragod district; the others are Kasaragod and Kanhangad. Nileshwaram is located on the estuary of Kavvayi Backwaters and Neeleshwaram River. Nileshwaram is referred to as the cultural capital of Kasaragod, the northernmost district of Kerala. "The first Chief Minister of Kerala and communist leader E. M. S. Namboodiripad, Kamaran Nair had contested elections to the Assembly from the Neeleshwaram segment."

wikipedia.title: Nileshwar Muthappan Madappura
wikipedia.text: Nileshwar Muthappan Madappura is a temple of the Hindu god Muthappan in the town of Nileshwar of Kasaragode district, Kerala state, South India.

wikipedia.title: Udinoor
wikipedia.text: Udinoor  is a village in Kasaragod district in the state of Kerala, India.

wikipedia.title: Pattena
wikipedia.text: Pattena is part of Nileshwar municipality in Kerala, India.

wikipedia.title: Kottappuram, Kasaragod
wikipedia.text: Kottappuram is a backwater destination, commonly known as "Valiyaparamba backwaters", located near Nileshwaram town in Kasargod district of Kerala, India. Kottappuram is situated 40 km south of Kasaragod, a  part of Nileshwar municipality.

wikipedia.title: Perole
wikipedia.text: Perole is a village and part of the Nileshwaram Municipality in Hosdurg taluk of Kasaragod district, Kerala, India. It is located 1.5 km east of Nileshwaram town.

Nileshwaram or Neeleswaram/Nileshwar is a small town in Kasaragod District in Malabar, Kerala, India.

== Do ==

Boating @ Kottappuram — Eleven houseboats are available for rent. Conference hall, AC bedroom, balcony, toilets and arrangements for riverbaths are available in them. Radio, TV and computer are there inside the boats. Capacity 20 to 80 people in different boats.
 Interact with the revolutionaries, V.S.Auto Stand, Bus stand. The autorikshaw drivers of Nileshwar are in a class of their own because they have formed a small group of anti-mainstream-communist socialist group and worship rebel leader V.S.Achuthanandan with great passion. (updated Aug 2015)
 Meet the artisans, Weavers' Street.  (updated May 2015)
 Sea Walks @ Cheruvathur Fishing Harbour, Kavum chira, Madakkara. Two footpaths of 800 m each length into the sea are available at Cheruvathur Fishing harbour. (updated Aug 2015)
 Sunset @ Thaikadappuram Azhithala. Azhithala, a picnicker's delight, is the place where River Tejaswani mouths the Arabian Sea. Situated about 9km from Nileshwar and 17 km from kanhangad, Azhithala is an ideal place for relaxation and long walks. (updated May 2016)
 Travel by public ferry. The boat station is 2 km from market junction on the highway. Boat services are available to Payyanur, Valyaparmba and Trikaripur. (updated May 2015)
 Trekking @ Cheruvathoor, East side of the Railway Station (2 km). Start from the railway station. Head South. Turn left to the hill on the eastern side. You reach the highway where there is a view point. On the highway, you can walk down south to Pilicode, another three kilometres. (updated Jun 2015)
 Watch the festivals. Festivals in Nileshwaram are Pooram and Kalasam in Mannampurathukavu, the festival in Thaliyil temple and Thrukarthika and Pooram in Pallikkara Bhagavathi Temple. Porat (ശാലീയ പൊറാട്ട്) in Anjoottabalam Veerarkavu, the Vishukkaliyattam festival in Thattacherry Vadayanthoor Kazhakam, and the Pooram festival in Cheermakkavu attract thousands of people in the month of Meenam. (updated May 2015)
 Watch the Theyyam dance. available in select temples and family temples. (updated May 2015)
 Kammadam Kavu Sacred Grove, Vellarikkundu. 60 acres of forest with rare birds and animals. Ancient Bhagavathy temple inside. (updated Mar 2019)
